items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: Torrie Zito and a lot of the guys that wrote for me so much

ctx.x: Then it came round. And I feel, and this has nothing to do with me it has to do with Torrie Zito and a lot of the guys that wrote for me so much — Dick Lee played bass trombone and still writes for me for the symphony. That was an unbelievable band, because they were all superstars in their own right and they were horrible to get along with because at the time they didn’t speak to each other. You know, I mean everybody had their own two-person clique.
